# Later Inbox / 나중함

> A shrinking read-later inbox: save a link with a required one-line why, keep at most 3 as this-week, auto-expire unpinned inbox items after 30 days.

This is a Progressive Web App (PWA) hosted at https://later-inbox.try-dabble.com/
All data stays in the browser (localStorage key later-inbox:items:v1). No accounts, no server-side storage.

This is NOT a reader, highlighter, AI summarizer, or Pocket-style folder/tag library.

## Pages

- [Home](https://later-inbox.try-dabble.com/): Add URL + why, weekly triage (max 3), pin, expire, search, export/import
- [Privacy](https://later-inbox.try-dabble.com/privacy.html): Privacy policy
- [Terms](https://later-inbox.try-dabble.com/terms.html): Terms of use
- [Guide](https://try-dabble.com/guides/later-inbox): How-to on try-dabble.com

## Features

- Add a URL (required) and a one-line why (required); optional title
- Paste URL from clipboard
- Inbox / This week (max 3) / Done / Expired
- Pin survives the 30-day auto-expire
- On load, unpinned inbox items older than 30 days become expired
- Weekly triage banner when the inbox is not empty
- Search title, why, and URL
- Netscape bookmarks.html import as drafts (why required before they count as saved)
- JSON export/import
- Multi-language UI: Korean, English, Japanese, Chinese
- Installable PWA with network-first service worker
